subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC plan — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (Acme Corp)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acme-corp.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed PoC approach (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Samir / Lena — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap from my side and a proposed PoC/trial plan so we can lock next steps: 

What I heard:
- Primary goal: validate inference latency and cost for customer-facing summarization feature (500–1k QPS bursts, ~10k requests/day steady).
- Concern: predictable latency under burst and data residency/privacy for some datasets (contains PII).
- Stakeholders: Samir (Head ML), Lena (Infra), Priya (Security) — we'll need Priya for compliance sign-off.

Deployment options we discussed:
- Hosted API: fastest to start, no infra on your side, good for feature validation.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools for predictable latency and throughput at scale.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): needed if full data isolation or strict network controls are required.

Proposed PoC approach (flexible):
1) Week 0–1: Quick Hosted API trial to validate baseline throughput and functional correctness (low friction).
2) Week 2: Spin up short Dedicated capacity window to measure p95/p99 under realistic burst loads and production model config.
3) Week 3: If security/data controls require, scope a Private VPC assessment (networking, KMS).

Success criteria (examples):
- p95 latency < 250ms for typical prompt profile
- sustained throughput for your peak bursts without >10% tail latency spikes
- per-token cost within agreed target (we can baseline after week 1)

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm the internal stakeholders and whether Priya should join the kickoff.
- Confirm target dates for the 3-week window (we can be flexible; earliest we can start is Apr 5).
- I'll circulate a short PoC MoM/agenda and SLA matrix (attached stub) and schedule a 60min kickoff.

Attached: PoC_MoM_Agenda.pdf (agenda + roles), SLA_matrix.xlsx (preliminary).

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your constraints.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Samir Patel <samir@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed PoC approach (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks Ben — solid recap. Couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Deployment preference: We currently lean toward Dedicated capacity for production because predictable latency is a hard requirement for the user experience. That said, we're open to starting with Hosted for quick validation as long as we can run a Dedicated window soon after to validate tail latency.

2) Data residency & PII: Some datasets we want to test include user-provided text with PII. If Hosted is used for baseline tests, we need clear handling and retention policies; Priya (sec) will need to review SOC2 evidence.

3) Scale targets: Peak bursts ~1k RPS for short periods, steady ~10k requests/day initially. Cost targets: we want a ballpark for per-call cost so we can model economics.

4) Stakeholders & availability: I'll be primary for ML; Lena will own infra + networking details; Arjun (Eng) will help run load tests. Priya (Security) should be invited for the week-2 Dedicated run.

If Apr 5 works, we'll plan for a kickoff then. Can you include our engineering runbook items in the agenda (IP whitelisting, rate limits, model config)?

Samir
Head of ML, Acme Corp
samir@acme-corp.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed PoC approach (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Appreciate the clarifications, Samir — that's very helpful. Updated/firm PoC plan below based on your notes: 

Proposed 3-week PoC (detailed):
- Week 1 (Apr 5–11): Hosted API baseline
  - Goal: functional correctness, quick latency baseline, and initial cost estimates using sampled production prompts.
  - Deliverable: baseline report (latency percentiles, token counts, cost estimate).

- Week 2 (Apr 12–18): Dedicated capacity window
  - Goal: validate p95/p99 under burst profiles and confirm autoscale behavior.
  - Deliverable: performance report, recommended Dedicated sizing and estimated monthly commit.

- Week 3 (Apr 19–25): Security & VPC scoping (if required)
  - Goal: confirm network requirements, KMS integration, and timeline for Private deployment if needed.
  - Deliverable: preliminary network runbook and high-level timeline for Private option.

Success criteria (to sign off PoC):
- p95 latency < 250ms under defined test workload
- no functional regressions on model outputs vs baseline prompts
- agreed cost estimate within +/-20% of projected figure

Action items for this week:
- Samir: confirm Priya for week-2 security review and provide network contact for Lena to coordinate IP allowlist.
- Lena: if you can share expected burst test window (dates/times), we can align the Dedicated window.
- Marissa (cc): I'll hand off scheduling and the kickoff invite to you once dates confirmed.

I'll update the PoC_MoM_Agenda.pdf with the runbook items you mentioned and re-share before kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Hi all — jumping in from CS to coordinate the kickoff and technical onboarding. Apr 5 (Tue) 10:00–11:00 PT works for a 60-min technical kickoff unless you prefer another slot. Proposed agenda (attached in PoC_MoM_Agenda.pdf): intros, test plan, network/IP requirements, data handling & retention, success metrics, next steps.

Items I need from Acme prior to kickoff:
- Point of contact for network (IP allowlist) + test nodes for load generation
- Any internal compliance questionnaire items Priya wants us to pre-populate
- Example prompt set (anonymized) for baseline runs

We have attached: PoC_MoM_Agenda.pdf (agenda + roles) and SLA_matrix.xlsx (preliminary SLOs and suggested fallbacks). I'll also upload the HubSpot playbook link to the related_links once the deal is created.
